name: Psalms
title: Psalms — The Prayerbook of the King and His People
tagline: Every human cry under the reign of Yahweh.

author.traditional: David and many others; collected for temple/synagogue/church.

date.range_display: Spans monarchy to post-exile in collection.

christ: The Psalms speak of Him (Luke 24:44); Son of Ps 2; Priest-King of Ps 110; forsaken cry of Ps 22.
spirit: Inspired songs; Spirit helps us pray.
jesus_in_this_book: The Psalms speak of Him (Luke 24:44); Son of Ps 2; Priest-King of Ps 110; forsaken cry of Ps 22.
how_to_read: Pray them. Do not only analyze them.
watchman_charge: Let the Psalter set your mouth on watch — lament honestly, praise fiercely.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
